construction: Public observable protocol, fixed event sequences and independent opaque providers; specified before reference implementation.

opportunities.label: 成功、输入顺序、并发上限与后续批次重入
work异常后等待兄弟工作与资源收口
外部取消传播与取得资源的恰一次释放
事件截止不伪装成功并等待清理
提交拒绝/ack错误不重试且不泄漏
取消等待acquire不伪造资源所有权

acquire抛错不释放未取得资源
预置截止、空/非法输入与批次隔离

tolerance: Exact ownership/terminal counts and values; no machine-dependent millisecond performance threshold. Watchdogs only bound nontermination.
free_implementation: No internal field/status/task naming, source string, exact patch, coroutine scheduling or private implementation assertions.
